browser-lab.description: Browser lab spike: only the control strip (labbar, a local page) talks to Tauri. The page webview (labpage) renders arbitrary web content and deliberately gets NO capabilities — it is untrusted.

window-frame.description: The windows are undecorated: the UI's own chrome drags and closes them. The daemon's origin is listed under remote because the main window loads the served UI — without it every window.* call from that page is refused by the ACL, which is exactly why the first injected buttons were dead.
